title: Update form/survey metadata
description: Adjust the form title, submission handling, mail settings, and validation/access rules for this survey.

elements.name: title
elements.title: Title of form
elements.description: Internal and public name of the form.

elements.name: description
elements.title: Form description
elements.placeholder: Explain purpose, audience, and submission context.
elements.description: Optional helper text shown with the form.

elements.name: actions
elements.title: Submission handling
elements.description: Pick every workflow that should trigger on submit.

elements.name: post_endpoint_url
elements.title: POST endpoint URL
elements.description: Submissions will be sent as JSON when POST is enabled.

elements.name: actions_help
elements.html:
Action types explained
  • Store in database: Saves each submission in configured storage, either inside Plone (ZODB) or in an external relational database.
  • Mail (with attachments): Sends an email and attaches selected export formats.
  • Mail (notification only): Sends a lightweight notification email without result attachments.
  • POST to endpoint: Sends submission data as JSON to the configured external URL.
  • Select all: Quickly enables all available action types above.

pages.name: page_mail
pages.title: Mail
pages.description: Configure sender, recipients, content, and attachments used when the "Mail (with attachments)" action is enabled.

elements.name: email_to
elements.title: Recipient
elements.description: Primary recipient. Required with Mail action.

elements.name: email_formats
elements.title: Attachments
elements.description: Select which export formats of the collected form data should be attached to the email.

pages.name: page_mail_notifications
pages.title: Mail notifications
pages.description: Notification emails send a short alert about a new submission without attachments, unlike the "Mail (with attachments)" action which sends exported submission files.

elements.name: email_notification_body
elements.title: Notification body
elements.description: Message sent for notification-only emails. Supports {title}, {detail_url}, {poll_id}.

elements.name: mail_notification_placeholders_help
elements.html:
Available placeholders
  • {title}: Survey title
  • {detail_url}: Link to the submission detail page
  • {poll_id}: Submission identifier

elements.name: force_server_side_validation
elements.title: Force server-side validation
elements.description: Always validate submissions on the server before processing.

elements.name: max_payload_size_mb
elements.title: Max payload size (MB)
elements.description: Maximum accepted request size for one submission.

elements.name: access_mode
elements.title: Access mode
elements.description: Choose whether the form is public or requires a trusted access token.

elements.name: trusted_access_ttl_hours
elements.title: Trusted token lifetime (hours)
elements.description: How long trusted access tokens remain valid.

pages.name: page_dates
pages.title: Dates
pages.description: Control when this survey becomes visible and when it should expire.

elements.name: effective
elements.title: Effective
elements.description: Optional. Leave empty to make the survey effective immediately.

elements.name: expires
elements.title: Expires
elements.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep the survey available.
